# QuantumReservoirThermodynamics

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The study of thermodynamic properties, such as entropy and free energy, in quantum reservoir computing systems to understand their computational capacity and stability. Bridges quantum thermodynamics with neuromorphic computing, enabling energy-aware design of in-network quantum reservoirs for efficient TCC/iNEST architectures.
